title: Magic Shop Simulator Demo
description: Run a magic shop in an open voxel world. Forage rare ingredients, brew potions at your cauldron, and sell them to a village of fantastical customers, then defend your shelves when the wilds come knocking. Cozy where you want it, dangerous the moment you push your luck.

title: Wizard Tournament Demo
description: Wizard Tournament is a tower-building autobattler where every run is a puzzle of placement, economy, and magical item synergies.Dive into the free demo,  giving you the chance experience every element of the game with only ranked and co-op mode disabled.

title: Lilac Prose Demo
description: A raw, cruel story about addiction, abuse, and recovery. A young man, bound by a vial of morphine, and a world that gives him just that, so long as there's a drop of him worth taking. It has to get worse before it gets better.

title: Disaster Scenario Demo
description: A comedic deckbuilder dressed up as a game show. Clear a gauntlet of absurd disasters with ridiculous tool combos and a little luck. Bring a crowd for the raucous pitch-and-bet party game — or go solo for a sharper, strategic run. First to the finish wins.

title: Bore Bore Demo
description: Bore Bore DEMO

title: Scarlet's Last Call Demo
description: Scarlet's Last Call is a 2.5D cyberpunk beat 'em up. By night she runs a neon bar; by dawn she hunts bounties. Play as deadly femme fatale Scarlet in her sexy outfits and tear through cyber-gangs, hounds, and bosses with brutal combos and cinematic finishers. Every contract could be her last call.

title: Circuit Keep Demo
description: Your towers don't stop anything. Enemies walk straight over them. The only thing that turns them aside is a wall, so you build the maze yourself. Then the intrusions start fighting back. PHASE slides through your walls. HOPPER vaults over them. BREAKER eats them. You built the maze. Now defend it.

title: Exiled Ark Demo
description: You play as a survivor to build strongholds, scavenge resources, forge weapons, and battle inside and outside the vessel, while gradually repairing its damaged cabins. Space survival exploration, roguelike combat, six attribute cultivation systems and four tech trees with multiple endings to unlock.

title: Transit Demo
description: Transit is a dark narrative adventure starring a sarcastic sock puppet in a world looping itself to death. Ride midnight trains through collapsing timelines, free traumatised souls, and search for your sister lost inside the loop.

title: 价值投资者：50年生涯 Demo
Onward! Autobattles Demo
description: Plan your line-up, set your formation and unleash devastating synergies to crush your enemies. Win battles to unlock more unique units and powerful artifacts in Onwards! Autobattles - a roguelike autobattler, where positioning is everything.

title: Scenic Demo
description: A relaxing pixel-art escape room game where you uncover hidden secrets and solve reality-bending puzzles. Interact with the environment and get lost in its liminal beauty.

title: ECHO Demo
description: A precision platformer built around one rule: you leave echoes of yourself behind.Place an echo mid-jump — it becomes solid. A platform. A shield. A bridge. You carry three at a time. Every placement is a decision; every deletion, a second chance.One mechanic. Infinite depth. How it worksYour echoes aren't decorations — they're tools.

title: Moonset Proyect Demo
description: An action shooter against hordes of zombies where you must survive and resist increasingly dangerous waves in emblematic locations on the Costa del Sol.

title: The Bestest Knight Demo
description: Travel to the end of the world in this auto scroller RPG. Craft unique builds, discover powerful item combos, and transform your fragile stable boy into the Bestest Knight. In this DEMO version you can explore the first region and play until the rank of Elite Knight.

title: Magine: War of Restoration Demo
description: A real-time strategy game anyone can pick up, featuring “click-to-deploy” and “zero micromanagement”. On a continent of magic and engine, gather your remnants, rebuild under siege and restore a shattered empire. Say goodbye to complex RTS controls and enjoy the pure joy of strategy and epic battles!

title: Dark Rail Demo
description: Turn-based management roguelike. Command the Inquisition and rule an industrial city on the empire’s edge. Use your train to meet prisoner shipment quotas by hunting heretics and slaying magical beasts. Produce supplies, contain revolt, and sacrifice prisoners to stop the madness.

title: Columbine Demo
description: "One ending gives rise to the next wish." A dark story-driven 2D shooter with multiple endings.

title: Grease Trap '99 Demo
description: Story-driven Mystery Horror / Comedic Takeaway Simulator. Deep-fry pizzas and live the Scottish dream. Voice-acted in Scottish Gaelic; subtitles in English or Gaelic.

title: Incremental Frog Demo
description: Incremental Frog is a game where you catch insects with your tongue. Catch flies, earn gold and upgrade your tech tree.

title: Guardian of Boss Neko - Demo
description: Guardian of Boss Neko is a 2D anime-style survivor-like game with integrated guardian mechanics. Players take on the role of a young female escort and protect Boss Neko the catgirl from waves of monster attacks.

title: LunaGenesis Demo
description: LunaGenesis is a single-player psychological horror adventure about Scary Moonchild, an avatar of Will who sneaks through the plague-ridden rat-folk town of Brume and explores surreal dreams to collect information and expose what the Collegium is hiding.

title: Solar Core Demo
description: Survive to the end of each track in fast, rhythm-driven combat in this top down twin-stick roguelike.

title: Ribbit Riot! Demo
description: Ribbit Riot! is a one-button chaos game where you unleash idiot frogs to destroy a tiny city. Click the frog button, stack absurd upgrades, and watch everything spiral out of control.

title: Gniewomir Demo
description: Open-world RPG with deck-building elements allowing you to combat mad storks and probably a god or two when the game will be finished. So far there are only storks. But fear not, plenty of magical creatures are on their way.

title: Soup's Tail Demo
description: Find out what it means to be dead. Explore the mystery of the afterlife, meet new characters, pet the cat, find cards, and earn collectables in this single player, narrative-driven game. As the story unfolds, play cards with those you meet along the way.

title: Mr. "Bargain Expert" 捡漏王 Demo
description: Play as an antique shop owner in this incremental idle management game. Buy low and sell high, appraise and acquire valuable antiques, hire employees to automate the business, expand into new branches, build your own antique empire, and collect rare treasures.

title: Silent Protocol Demo
description: Silent Protocol is a top-down experimental action arcade game that focuses on precise movement with mouse control, featuring unique one of a kind experience.

title: Yokai Crossing Demo
description: A 7-year-old boy has vanished inside his own home. Find him and uncover what happened beneath its walls, while evading the Yōkai that have claimed this place as their own.

title: 鸡瘟检察官：最后的IKUN Demo
Holdline: Last Gate Demo
description: Holdline: Last Gate is a third-person tower-defense survival game. Harvest resources, craft and place towers, and hold the gate across a chain of diverse alien maps as the wave fights you on every front at once.

title: Being and Becoming Demo
description: Being & Becoming is an atmospheric metroidvania, set in a dying kingdom held together only by the collective dream of thousands of would-be martyrs. Fate itself is against you as The Word’s prophecy unfolds. Rewrite your place within The Word or become a scripted part of this horrible revelation.

title: The Ice is Watching Demo
developer: Oguz Abdullah Celik, Seyit Alashan, Hasan Yuce

title: Lane Wars Demo
description: Command your legion in a dark-fantasy lane auto-battler. Raise free-producing barracks, summon 10 unique heroes, gear them up, and smash the enemy base across two lanes. Pure strategy — no unit micro. Outwit the AI. Free to play.

title: Imprinted Demo
description: An audio restoration job becomes an investigation into the occult, as an elusive musician’s damaged cassette tapes are exhumed in northern Italy. Use a fully-operational desktop to sift through files, descending into the artist’s world in this slow-burning ghost tale of creativity and obsession.

title: Glintseeker Island Demo
description: Descend into mysterious caves with countless treasures to excavate in a mining exploration adventure. Upgrade your gear, fight bosses, uncover secrets and save the island from an ancient threat below!

title: Dead End: Escape Your Fears Abducted Demo
description: Trapped in a small room with dead animals sounds like anyone's worst fear, but what awaits you on the other side of the door? Puzzles are hidden in the most unexpected places, and even if you're clever enough to solve them... What makes you think the Millers will let you escape?

title: Roads & Riches: Traveling Merchant Simulator Demo
description: Hit the road with your merchant caravan! Travel across faraway lands, sell wonderful wares, and find magical treasures - all to win over the world's hearts, minds... and wallets!

title: Mayak Demo
description: A signal from a star // 3571 → 3559 → 3557 → … → 0 // 336 years remain // You and her, staring up at the sky. A hand-drawn sci-fi visual novel about first contact.

title: Balls Together Demo
description: It’s not just a ball anymore, it’s your power. Roll, bump, and compete! Balls Together is a chaotic multiplayer party game where you control a ball and challenge friends in racing, soccer, party modes and crazy modes. Climb the global leaderboards and compete worldwide.

title: Dark Roll 2 Demo
description: A Souls-like inspired 3D platformer built around physics-based rolling, where every mistake can send you tumbling into danger. You’ll take on a series of uniquely designed levels packed with unforgiving environmental hazards that test your agility, logic, perseverance, and sanity.

title: GLANCED Demo
description: Step inside. Infiltrate the manor of porcelain dolls, some are maybe your friends. Steal the key from her cold neck, find the door, and whatever you do, don’t meet her eyes. One glance is enough to lose your body. GLANCED: forget FPS shooters. Here, just a look...KILLS. Now, just survive.

title: Guildrun Demo
description: Turn a simple team into an unstoppable force and crush waves of monsters in this PvE autobattler roguelike demo. No two runs feel the same as you bend heroes beyond their class roles and discover countless combinations and synergies. Seal the rifts at your own pace and uncover what tore them open.

title: Primal One Demo
description: Primal one is a first-person dinosaur survival horror set in an installation in the cretaceous period. Hide and evade dinosaurs that are hunting you, while you try to find a way to go back to the present alive or contact survivors in other installation.

title: Tickets, Please! Demo
description: Become a train conductor and run your own train in a relaxed cozy simulation! Check tickets, keep everything clean, repair defects, and upgrade your train. Experience humorous chaos on rails in a relaxed yet hectic single-player experience.

title: NOMAD-san Demo
description: This is a coffee-break roguelike. Can you claim the Crown of Victory on the 31st floor? In the demo, you can play as one of the playable characters from the full version.

title: Twisted Ball Pool Demo
description: Twisted Ball Pool is a roguelite billiards game with unique table layouts, trick shots, and cue abilities you unlock to master every run!

title: Bonehearts Demo
description: In Bonehearts you control two clashing skeletons, one meek - one mighty, who are forced to share a body. Rip off your arm to bonk enemies, throw your head and maneuver it around. Use your skeletal abilities to defeat evil and explore a Halloween-inspired world in this humorous 3D-platformer.

title: Floor Glitch Demo
description: Escape from the anomalous 8-storey apartment building, where each floor gives you new challenges. You won't be able to just go down or use the elevator, the house will keep bringing you back until you solve the main task on each floor... Demo version contains only 8th floor.

title: Doodle Ball Demo
description: A cozy physics puzzle game where you draw lines with different properties to gently guide a ball and pick up all collectibles. Solve each challenge at your own pace in a world of cute, hand-drawn art.

title: The Gambit Lost to Time Demo
description: Become a time-travelling goddess entrusted with saving the world in this roguelike tactical RPG! With powers capable of altering time and terrain - serve one of three distinct, warring factions, and unite them over many timelines to break free from a time loop of doom.

title: Pinkybites Demo
description: A 400 year old vampire wakes up in a band's basement with a stake hole in her chest and nowhere to go. She strikes a deal, front the band, win the Battle of the Bands, figure out what a dollar is. A story driven visual novel about music, found family, and a heart that forgot it could feel.

title: 弈统三国：三国五子棋 Demo
description: Three Kingdoms Gomoku combines classic Gomoku with Three Kingdoms themes and general skills. You can freely build decks from various factions, utilize generals' abilities to create brilliant tactical combos, and enjoy the unique fun of skill-based Gomoku.

title: Happy Little Farm Demo
description: Happy Little Farm is a cozy incremental farming game where you grow a small, happy farm with cute animals. Plant crops, care for animals, and enjoy peaceful days. However, after the sun goes down, it may be best not to check whether the animals are truly happy.

title: Colorful Craftworks Demo
description: Colorful Craftworks is a 2D puzzle game where you paint objects to change their properties and create new paths. Use colors to extinguish flames, transform obstacles, and solve carefully designed stages filled with creative, trial-and-error based challenges.

title: WARPED Demo
description: WARPED is a fast, retro-inspired twin-stick space shooter where you blast UFOs, destroy asteroids, upgrade your ship, and fight across the solar system with your robot companion Zippy to uncover the source of a mysterious signal.

title: Fire Bug Demo
description: Hold the sun in your hand in this fast-paced arcade game. Play as a magnifying glass and cook swarms of bugs before time runs out. Chain ignitions, defeat tier bosses, and spend your Sparks on upgrades tree to unlock explosive criticals, burn trails, and smoldering spore clouds.

title: Market at Moonfall Demo
description: Build a thriving fantasy marketplace by day, then defend it from monsters by night in this cozy management game with action, strategy, and endless customization.

title: Mourning House Demo
description: After a terrifying encounter on a lonely road, a man awakens inside a mysterious house where his wife has vanished. Solve puzzles, uncover dark secrets, and find a way to escape before it's too late.

title: Juice Stand Tycoon Demo
description: Juice Stand Tycoon is a casual business simulation game about growing a small neighborhood juice stand into a busy local favorite.Each day starts with planning. Buy ingredients, adjust your recipes, set prices, and decide whether to spend money on upgrades or advertising.

title: Flipping Out Demo
description: Flipping Out is a pinball rage game. Think: "Getting Over It" meets pinball. Control the flippers on a giant pinball machine, flinging the ball higher and higher. Be careful though - one wrong flip can send you cascading to the ground.

title: Her Remember You Demo
description: An AI desktop Live-Action companion who truly remembers you. Featuring real conversation memory, smart memo system, emotional, and support for both local offline models and cloud APIs. she learns you grows with you. Choose from multiple beautifully animated characters,each with a unique personality.

title: Run Chubby Run Demo
description: In this DEMO, you can enjoy 1 complete level of gameplay, in which you run while a Bear chases you, you can scare it away by waving a torch, while jumping over obstacles, consuming fruit to maintain your energy and discovering collectible medals for achievements, all while escaping.

title: Origins TCG Demo
description: The 1st free-2-compete TCG. Compete on skill alone (zero pay-to-win) for limited digital cards you can trade, grade, and sell!

title: My Racing Car Demo
description: Drag rusted wrecks from the scrapyard and rebuild them from scratch, one part at a time. A raw open-world driving life-sim — fix your car, fuel it, and hit the road. Race for cash, explore a living forest town, and survive the grind. Drive. Don't stop.

title: Mike the Hooper Demo
description: Mike the Hooper is a 2D basketball puzzle platformer where you shoot hoops, open doors, and help Mike get home. Find your way through each level, make tricky shots, and overcome platforming challenges along the way.

title: Untitled Ghost Game Demo
description: You are dead, now make it everyone else's problem.

title: Nui Goes to Town! Demo
description: Nui Goes to Town is a psychological horror game where you explore and interact with various animals - helping them with chores and discovering the dark secrets behind the world around you. You cut grass, dig holes, and stab....things.

title: Railpunk Mayhem Demo
description: All aboard! Enjoy a unique, fast-paced roguelike action experience. In Railpunk Mayhem, survive relentless waves of enemies at breakneck speeds, build a powerful train to manage your crew, and strategically plan your route to the source of chaos.

title: Grim Path Demo
description: A roguelike card crawler where every step is a choice. Descend into dark dungeons, battle monsters, and face various encounters. Choose your gear wisely to survive and go even deeper.

title: Architects of the Universe: The Orbital Wars Demo
Resort Architect Demo
description: Build and manage your dream resort from the ground up! Design beautiful guest rooms, welcome visitors, prepare delicious meals, and grow a small hotel into a thriving vacation paradise!

title: Crownrats Demo
description: Crownrats is a co-op colony RPG where mouse heroes explore locations, capture rooms, mine resources, build a home colony and resist rival warrens. Play solo with bots or together in quick tactical runs.

title: Doom Reignite Demo
description: The apocalypse crisis erupts again, and mutated zombies threaten the only humans left. As a member of the Atlas Doomsday Squad, explore survival in a Roguelike world with a Lowpoly art style, gather resources, refine gear, and seek a path forward for humanity.
developer: Chengdu Shengming Leyou Network Technology Co., Ltd.

title: 8BIT HUNTER Demo
description: Protect villages as an 8-Bit Hunter in this nostalgic top-down retro game! Defeat monsters, robbers, and bandits. Earn money for weapons & upgrades by completing quests.

title: Wild East: The Straw Man Demo
description: A 1990s point-and-click mystery set in post-communist Slovakia. Play as journalist Marek Varga and follow the first trail through dead ends, missing papers, old apartments, and people with reasons to lie.

title: The Duke is Dead Demo
description: The official demo for the upcoming detective game The Duke is Dead! Collect clues, solve puzzles, and use deduction to find the killer. Put your skills to the test to unravel the trail of crimes and uncover the truth!

title: Citadels - Shadow City Demo
description: Welcome to the Citadels: Shadow City DemoStep into the world of Citadels: Shadow City, a strategic turn-based card game of hidden roles, bluffing, and city-building set in a dark fantasy medieval world.In this demo, you'll get your first taste of the game's core mechanics:Build your city by constructing powerful districts.

title: Bound By A Curse Demo
description: A two-player asymmetric horror game where one player explores a dangerous environment while the other guides them from a control room. A curse causes you to swap positions throughout the game at random times, letting you experience both roles and creating chaotic moments.

title: ReDraft: The Fantasy Football Simulator Demo
Green Inferno Demo
description: A new kind of horror deduction game that allows you to investigate freely. In this demo, begin your investigation into a doomed expedition. Examine the first detailed scenes, collect clip-based evidence, and start connecting the clues to uncover a macabre, analog nightmare.

title: Complexia, A Ballet of Blades Demo
乌合之罪 Demo
description: 《乌合之罪》是一款校园霸凌复仇X悬疑惊悚恋爱的沉浸式AVG，你（玩家）所饰演的主人公将在与外界彻底断联的诡异孤岛上历经一场极端恶意的厮杀，请找回记忆，推进剧情，抵达十四年前遗落的真相……

title: Wall Street Tycoon Demo
description: Try the free demo of Wall Street Tycoon: click your way from broke intern to your first fortune. Play the full early game up to your first prestige, hit the casino, and ride the markets. Love it? Wishlist the full game!

title: Money Under The Bed Demo
description: You complained to a strange roadside statue about being broke—and the next day, a jar of money appeared under your bed. How do you plan to spend this windfall? Of course, you’re free to squander every cent... as long as you can survive until tomorrow.

title: Tale Sweeper Demo
description: Tale Sweeper blends incremental progression with light loot mechanics. Hack and slash monsters, complete quests, and gather gold and materials. Use your loot to upgrade a massive skill tree, craft powerful weapons, and buy potions to gear up for your next adventure!

title: Leave On Time Demo
description: Leave on Time is a co-op roguelite dungeon crawler about overtime, office absurdity, and fighting for your right to clock out. Technically up to 32 players depend on network.

title: I’m A Food Delivery Guy Demo
Royal Goldenbeak and the Curse of Snowy Island Demo
description: 2D Comic, Arcade, Adventure fighter. Hand Drawn, Awesome Soundtrack. Upgradeable abilities. Fun Boss Battles. Comic Book Dialogue style with NPCs. Linear, fighting game with obstacles, traps and puzzles. Forgiving checkpoints. Unforgiving enemies.

title: 疫区求生 Demo
description: "Infected Zone Survival" is an open world zombie apocalypse survival game. The game is mainly based on third person action shooting, and can be searched, disguised, built, made, cultivated, fished,hunted, recruited NPCs, simulated management, etc.

title: Witch & Dragon: Hope of Elements Demo
description: Harness elemental chains to defeat foes, collect treasures, and craft unique builds in high-risk, high-reward adventures. Witch & Dragon: Hope of Elements is a roguelike with elemental gameplay, RPG mechanics, and turn-based tactics. Join Elise and dragon Pipi on their magical journey.

title: Shuffle Bistro Demo
description: A restaurant-themed deck-building roguelike that surpasses sales targets through the synergy of menu, facilities, and perks

title: Drone Soccer Demo
description: Pilot a caged racing drone as you dodge defenses to score goals or knock opponents out of the sky! We wanted to get the core flight simulation into your hands as soon as possible so you can start practicing. Master your skills in single-player modes today and prepare for the full release.

title: Haunted Echoes Demo
description: Haunted Echoes is a raw psychological horror game experienced through a bodycam perspective. Explore abandoned, eerie locations, manage your limited flashlight, face terrifying anomalies hidden in the dark, and try to survive a nightmare where every single move is being recorded.

title: Zyntaris Demo
description: Try the free demo version of Zyntaris: fight thousands of enemies, collect weapons and magical tomes, switch camera views, and defeat the final boss on the first map.

title: Steps To The Stars Demo
description: A single player puzzle game following the journey of two stars as they climb to return to the constellation from which they have fallen.

title: City of Hunger Demo
description: Survive a deadly parasite outbreak in immersive virtual reality. Fight for your life, uncover the truth behind Dr. Summers' experiments, and escape before it's too late.

title: A Case of Missing Identity [DEMO]
description: [1.5 ACT DEMO] A point-and-click horror/tragedy visual novel about melding your perception of the world around you. Walk around, drive people to their death, and shape Perdita's existence. Remember: The flesh-sin is nothing. Before she can become everything, you must make her into something.

title: I Like Trains Demo
description: You like trains? Good, you are going to need a lot of them. Grow from a single train line into a sprawling transporation network in this incremental train game. Move passengers, invest in more trains, new lines, unlock new buildings and of course, buy lots of upgrades.

title: Storm Grill Demo
description: A short incremental game where you play as a grill and fight against the storm! Evaporate raindrops, earn coins, unlock new upgrades and skills, grow stronger until you can outlast the downpour.

title: VIRUS_31.EXE Demo
description: A virus has breached the system. You have 3 minutes to contain it. Build a weapon system from cards, survive escalating chaos, and earn bits that compound into exponential power. A survivors-like with an incremental twist.

title: Harvestide Demo
description: Deckbuilding + farming Roguelike — Free Demo! Draw, plant, cast, and survive the Barren Moon. Chapter 1 included. Master dual resources and turn the tide with events. The Barren Moon awaits. Ready?

title: The Blade Demo
description: 2.5D Action Roguelite that fuses Hong Kong-style Action Cinema environmental interaction with hardcore martial arts combat.physics is as deadly as your blade. Kick&Launch: From small tea bowls to heavy mahogany tables—one well-placed kick turns mundane furniture into lethal projectiles.

title: Void Havoc Demo
description: In this sci-fi action/strategy game, you're the only trump card left to stop the Contingency in their destructive march. Man your ship, build your arsenal and blow away the waves sent to stop you in your tracks.

title: Bloodwright Demo
description: Descend through deadly procedural dungeons, claim powerful loot, and decide how deep you're willing to risk it all in this dark fantasy action RPG rogue-lite.

title: Egg Farm
description: Become the Ultimate Egg Farm Owner!Build your dream farm through relaxing idle progression while collecting resources and crafting your own overpowered egg build with a wide variety of random upgrades and powerful abilities.

title: Manggou demo
description: Dash at breakneck speed, slash mid-air, chain bizarre gadgets, dash and cut through a juice-bursting frenzy, become the fastest blade in the orchard.

title: Card: Heroes and Dispute Demo
description: In this unique strategy RPG, you must collect resources and recruit an army by stacking cards in a fantasy world. Explore mysterious rooms, ingeniously use limited space to assemble powerful combat units, and face turn-based boss battles.

title: Affiliated Homies Demo
description: Banana!Blast your homies in this casual ahh multiplayer game with absurd recoil. Even has voice chat >:p. Two Teams, One MissionJoin the Affiliated and protect your gold. OR play as an undercover cop on a mission to recover it all.

title: Tough Cat Demo
description: This is a survival shooter game where players must survive in a stationary shooting format. You can play effortlessly with only the mouse plus Q and W keys. You may enter the shop periodically to buy items to grow stronger and boost your survival odds, which serves as the core gameplay.

title: Pixel Three Kingdoms: Zombie Dungeon Demo
Cube Foundry Demo
description: Cube Foundry is a cosmic idle & incremental clicker. Click to forge cubes, automate with generators, and stack upgrades. Prestige to grow stronger, unleash Overclock surges, draw high-risk roguelite cards, brew potions, and tend the Cube Garden minigame.

title: BudMageddon Demo
description: Grow a cosmic cannabis empire in this chill pixel-art idle-clicker. Plant, grow, harvest, and automate the farm — then prestige across 10 alien sectors from Earth to Andromeda. Pure number-go-up bliss, with a green thumb. 🌱👽🚀

title: Bastion Heart Demo
description: A tactical tower defense where you can freeze time to reposition units mid-battle, gear them up with items, enhance them with skill trees, and unleash powerful abilities to clear massive waves of enemies and challenging bosses!

title: Democracy Manifest Alpha Demo
description: Hijack the vote in this 3-7 player social deduction brawl! It’s your job to craft the legislation cards on your desk into crowd-pleasing bills. Juggle with ideologies to play your cards perfectly, rig elections through deals, bribery & manipulation and backstab your closest friends to get ahead.

title: Project Quickgunner: Initial Run
description: Project Quickgunner is a linear, first-person shooter, multi-level game where you go on various missions from cityscapes, hidden laboratories, and more - finding important items and eliminating those who stand in your way.

title: Murder Meet Cute Demo
description: Look, just because I’m paid to fix computers, doesn’t mean I’ll sit here and listen to your life story. So what there’s been murders? Do I look like a detective?

title: LYNK: The Algorithm of Intimacy Demo
description: LYNK: The Algorithm of Intimacy is a dark psychological thriller that begins inside a dating app. It sees not just what you type, but your hesitation, silence, and hidden desires. As you chat with Nora, Mira, and Iris, the app starts learning who you really are. Every choice leaves a trace.

title: Stardust Protocol Demo
description: Between bullet hell, black markets, and star-map strategy, chart a branching route of your own. Combine Scatter, Missile, Homing, and Laser weapons with 100+ items and 30+ random events—each sortie reshapes your build. Balance risk and reward in unknown systems and blaze your trail through the void.

title: Descent of Yomi Demo
description: The free demo of Descent of Yomi, a Japanese-folklore roguelike deckbuilder. Play through Chapter 1 — forge your deck, cut down yokai, and master the killing blow and the "rewind of the afterlife." Enjoyed it? Wishlist the full game.

title: Deepforge Brawl Demo
description: Deepforge Brawl is a dwarven arena roguelite where your weapons fire themselves — you just have to survive. Charge your beard, chug your ale, dash through goblin hordes. The free demo is your first five waves: all six dwarves, the full Forge, your first boss. Your records carry into the full game.

title: Wisp: Elemental Conflict Demo
description: You start as a simple neutral Wisp. Absorb elemental motes, add elemental effects and strengthen your abilities, build your power, and survive a world that's already at war with itself. 12 elements. 11 abilities. 12 bosses. Permanent progression. Every run, a new chance.

title: Sword of Ace Demo
description: A punishing 3rd-person soulslike action RPG set in a blood-soaked Gothic Horror Victorian world. Step into the armor of a final knight from the Sword of Ace Order, wield your iron sword against terrifying demonic hordes, and fight to survive the grim, mysterious remnants of a fallen civilization.

title: Fatemender Demo Version
description: A Tarot puzzle adventure where you collect cards, cast spells, and place paths to reshape an ever-shifting Labyrinth. Outsmart the Fates, collect powerful Artifacts, and attempt the impossible—escape Purgatory.

title: Tactichord: Glam Strategy Demo
description: 1990. End of an era. Glam metal is on the ropes and one band is thrashing the local music scene. Fight for freedom from the mediocrity of your high school life, turning foes into fans while making lyrical choices during battle to create your own rock anthems. Turn-based tactics turned up to eleven!

title: content moderator. Demo
description: To pay for your mother's surgery, you take on a shady part-time job: "content moderator" Your task is to delete the "forbidden images" that must never see the light of day. Survive the creeping curses of this abnormal office.

title: 在落叶堆之外 Demo
description: In Toronto's cold, dry, pitch-black polar night, a four-string bass roars in a freezing basement. Sink into punker Jack's drug‑induced, hallucinatory "trip"—face the overwhelming unease through twisted fluid colors and a torn, fractured vision.

title: Tube2K Demo
description: Build the video sharing platform that will change the world. Will you bring about the Golden Age of humanity or bring it to its knees?

title: HollowCity:EscapeFromSeoul Demo
description: HollowCity is a top-down extraction shooter where you venture out from your safehouse to explore and scavenge for loot. Seize spoils from hostile enemies, rescue allies to upgrade your base, and find your way out of the devastated city.

title: Dittung Dittung Demo
description: Dittung Dittung is a 2D stealth action game where Pippi, an adorable penguin, sneaks into a seal's hideout to reclaim the fish they stole from her colony. Use Pippi's unique penguin movements, hide using the environment, and outsmart dangerous predators to take back what's yours!

title: Find Cats 8 Magical Plant Kingdom Demo
CRUSHCHOP DEMO
description: From a hidden bastard son to the Lord of Sunlit City! Rebuild a burned realm through gambling in an arena of clashing warriors. You will gamble, rally soldiers, build castles, mine resources, raid giants, and do it all in CRUSHCHOP!

title: Heartbeat Impact Demo
description: Transform into a love-bearing pinball, smashing through every obstacle to break down the walls around her heart. Only by maintaining extreme high speed can you pierce through the barriers unscathed.

title: 末世信使 Demo
description: 《末世信使》是一款 Roguelike 策略背包管理游戏。每一次冒险都充满未知，你将收集随机的道具,遭遇随机的事件，自由构筑专属卡组、升级能力、打造定制武器。突破重重挑战，携手伙伴，一同拯救未来的末世世界！

title: Adamant of Honor Demo
description: Fight through a secret research facility overrun by robots, mutants, and hostile forces. Scavenge weapons, survive deadly encounters, and uncover the power of the mysterious Adamant Stone before humanity falls into chaos.

title: Seasonal Lockdown Demo
description: An anxiety inducing survival game where you must balance removing anomalies while keeping unstable robotics under control. You are an undercover agent discovering the dark secrets an establishment owner is hiding from the government.

title: The voodoo soldier Demo
description: In The Voodoo Soldier, your weapons consume your life. Miss your shots, waste your life. Kill enemies to make them drop what keeps you alive. Aggression fuels survival, and high health unlocks your deadliest weapons. Shoot. Heal. Survive.

title: HAM HOLE Demo
description: You've just awoken to your first day of a mandatory life sentence. You are one of many, tasked with solving an imminent national catastrophe. Between the horrid mystery meat they send down the tubes, to the disgusting infestation that makes it's home here, there is no glory to be found in this work.

title: Study Abroad Sim Demo
description: A life simulation game inspired by the real experiences of international students. Study, survive, pay rent, manage your mental health, and build your life in foreign cities across the world.

title: Carpet Cleaning Master Demo
description: Clean filthy carpets until they look new again. Follow each carpet’s rules, keep an eye on your water and electricity bills, and try not to think too hard about the company you work for. A cozy cleaning sim. Demo version!

title: Turbo Turkey: Feathered Frenzy! Demo
description: Thanksgiving is coming and you're on the menu. Run, jump, and shoot your way through 16 levels of Turkeyland in this platformer inspired by Donkey Kong Country and Crash Bandicoot. Collect pumpkins, race time trials, and prove you're no one's dinner.

title: Lunar Eclipse ~ Vol. 0 Demo
description: Tread lightly or perish! In this pixel style Action RPG, slash and dodge through grueling foes as a dreary elven swordsman and a conniving feline assassin, discover hidden secrets in expansive environments, and survive in a world healing from war.

title: According to the Emperor, Nothing Happened Demo
description: No empire lasts forever. Play devastating historical event cards, manipulate five core national attributes, and bring the greatest dynasties in Chinese history to collapse.

title: Laments of a Valiant Rose Demo
Butterfly: Twisted threads Demo
description: Butterfly: Twisted Thread is a hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania where you use a mystical butterfly to draw platforms, objects, and attack tools into the world. Explore interconnected areas, solve physics-based puzzles, fight enemies, and unlock new paths through creative drawing.

title: Temperhall 1402 Demo
description: This is a simulation game where you manage a medieval blacksmiths' guild, and your goal is to grow the guild from a small workshop into an influential association of craftsmen. The demo version includes the early stages of the guild's development.

title: Paws & Circuits: Reboot Earth
description: A cozy explovival game where you play a wounded raccoon and his helper drone, cleaning a polluted 4×4 km island, recycling trash, gathering plants and surviving weather, seasons and hunger while slowly rebooting nature.

title: Universalia Demo
description: Sling new worlds into orbit inside real photographed skies. A zen physics game about gravity, patience, and the quiet joy of watching something you made keep turning. Fifteen handcrafted star systems. Every failure is a beautiful explosion.

title: Dice Ark Demo
description: Roll dice to cross the ever-changing Ark, assign your results to cards in battle, and build your deck and fortune. Defeat monsters, control crystals, disrupt rival explorers, and win not by being the strongest, but by claiming the greatest total assets.

title: 幻想进度条 Fantasy Bar Demo
description: Fantasy Progress Bar is a medieval fantasy idle mobile game. Enjoy effortless AFK and free class switching, alongside mythical beast nurturing, equipment forging and mount exploration. You don’t need to keep your screen on — progress continues even offline.

title: DANCING ZOMBIE Demo
description: A sudden zombie outbreak has swept the city. You barely make it to a shelter, only to discover that five Host Dancing Zombies are hiding among the survivors, disguised as humans. Want to find them and take them down? Then, DANCE!

title: 平行线交点杀人事件 Demo
Baron Local Demo
description: Experience the opening chapter of your political career. Rise from an ordinary citizen to your first mayoral election in this political life simulator where every decision shapes your reputation, alliances, and future.

title: Atmospheric Labyrinth Demo
description: Search for unusual events inside a labyrinth of usual rooms. Walk through it, and see daily life differently.

title: NoOneKnowsME. Demo
description: You are an impostor inhabiting the body of a dead crew member. Blend in and live out your days on the ship without raising suspicion. Complete seven daily tasks, even as a strange atmosphere begins to take hold. Can you survive all seven days without being exposed?
developer: 箱詰めプロダクション

title: Craft in Peace Demo
description: A relaxing pixel-art survival crafting game. Gather resources, craft tools, build your home, and use magical teleportation to explore the forest.

title: Whiskers In The Sand Demo
description: Whiskers In The Sand mixes survivors-like arena combat with roguelite buildcrafting. Unlock new cats*, gather relics, stack upgrades, and forge ridiculous builds. Experiment, survive, and end the pharaoh's second reign. *: not available in the demo.

title: Bru & Boegie: Episode 2 - Get da SUGAR! Demo
description: What if every wild theory was actually true? Break out of jail, hunt down KiffTown’s stolen sugar, and unravel a bizarre alien conspiracy that revolves entirely around you. A fully-animated, fully-voiced 2D point-and-click comedy adventure packed with the duo's signature laconic and sardonic wit.

title: The Missing Rune Demo
description: This is a Demo for The Missing Rune:The Missing Rune is a psychological horror simulation. [“The Missing Rune” executable may also be designated as OBJ-SP-611. The following is an instructional guide.] You will simulate a low level researcher in the O.B.J.

title: The Last Frame Demo
description: Experience the opening chapter of The Last Frame. Explore your late father's abandoned workshop, restore your first painting, and enter the first surreal memory. Solve the introductory VR puzzles and discover the beginning of the story before continuing in the full game.

title: ShapesFoundry Demo
description: Your stats, on top of the game. A no-code studio for live hardware dashboards: build unlimited custom widgets from CPU, GPU, temps and fans, then drop them as a click-through game overlay. No coding needed; power users also get a full formula engine.

title: Slotbound Demo
description: A roguelike auto-battler defense where luck meets strategy. Spin a 3x3 slot machine to summon units and grow your army by absorbing others. Use Items and Cores to manipulate the odds and survive challenging judgement waves and boss waves. Every spin and every choice counts.

title: Vibe Train Demo
description: A cozy, casual train-themed desktop idle game. Explore the world by rail. Equip a variety of train cars, and grow crops, haul cargo, trade goods, and carry passengers along the way.

title: Uncast: Duel of Wizards Demo
description: A roguelite wizard dueling game where two wizards battle each other with epic spells, 4 interacting elements, and lots of potions. Master the magical combat and uncast the enemy wizard at the end of the battle. Earn crystals and unlock the most powerful spells, wands, wizards and upgrades.

title: 保卫粮食 Grain Defense Demo
description: This is a game that combines tower defense, survivor‑like, and Hearthstone Battlegrounds‑style mechanics. You play as a farmer, and you will be attacked by pests coming from all directions. You can buy crops from the shop to defend against the pests.

title: Wonderland Gacha House - Muster - Demo
description: A cute figurine Bullet Heaven roguelite set in tiny household battlefields. Build, collect, and clear monster hordes with no microtransactions, duplicates, or shards.

title: Lifeguard Simulator Demo
description: Experience the first steps of a professional lifeguard's career in Lifeguard Simulator. Complete your lifeguard certification, master rescue equipment, patrol the beach, respond to emergencies, and keep visitors safe. The demo offers a glimpse into the daily responsibilities of a lifeguard.

title: Compile & Defend Demo
description: A tower defense game where you don't click to shoot — you write code your towers run every tick, in Python, JavaScript, C++, C#, Rust, Zig or Lua. Prioritize threats with if, sweep swarms with for, and route air, armor and camo to the right tower. Better algorithms beat more towers.

title: Click&Fix Demo
description: Click&Fix is an incremental game about repairing consoles in which you unlock upgrades and machines to repair and resell increasingly expensive consoles.

title: Age of Legacy Demo
description: Age of Legacy is an unforgiving roguelike RPG with intense turn-based 1v1 combat. Choose a class to define your tactical approach, and hunt unique equipment and powerful runestones. Survival is key, because death means game over!

title: ぺちぺちハクスラ Demo
description: A hack-and-slash RPG where you defeat monsters, gather materials, and grow stronger through equipment crafting and skills. The more you upgrade, the faster your material farming becomes! Watching your stats steadily rise is irresistibly addictive!

title: Dyeversion Demo
description: Dyeversion is a color-routing tower defense. Drag liquid hoses from color sources to your towers, mix colors to forge powerful COMBO towers, and route your pipes around the enemy path. Battle dozens of levels, earn tokens, and unlock a deep skill tree.

title: 魑魅 离人之歌 Demo
description: 世有错过，亦有遗憾，唯有放下，方得成仙。但当人类真的跳出生老病死的长河，是幸运，抑或是诅咒？遗忘者得长生、堕落者享欲望、贪婪者失心智、杀戮者终成佛，在这座失去法律与道德约束的长生古镇，不同的选择，终将带你走向不同的终点…… 可笑的是，有时候想着稍稍反抗下命运，然而反抗命运何尝不是命运的一部分？

title: The Last Student : Showa-Era Radio room Demo
description: A Showa-era school. A radio room at night. Your final dismissal announcement is answered by a mysterious voice: > "...I'm still here." Each broadcast reveals a new anomaly. **This demo includes the opening chapter of the story.**

title: 世纪末之诗 Demo
description: 1999年，千年世纪之交……再一次，并非恋爱的邂逅。 由原班人马带来的《泡沫冬景》正统续作，再次向视觉小说表现力的极限发起挑战。

title: Loop Tower Demo
description: Loop Tower tells the story of adventurers climbing an endless tower. Place it on a corner of your desktop and help them continue their ascent. Experience a fresh blend of desktop idle gameplay + roguelike + RPG right now!

title: Ironvale Demo
description: IRONVALE is a survival-crafting roguelike. Gameplay is split into a day/night cycle, where crafting, resource gathering, and building primarily happen during the day -- but at night, swarms of enemies attack the player and they must fight to survive.

title: Fragment Collapse Demo
description: Fragment Collapse is a satisfying tile matching rogue-like deck-builder where you defragment your hard drive by matching clusters of files. Discover powerful cartridges to upgrade your computer, boost your files with enhancements and build massive combos for file-busting mayhem!

title: World Tree Defender - Seedlings of Yggdrasil Demo
Malice in Wonderland Demo
description: Tear through Wonderland and break free of The Hatter's control in this fast-paced action roguelike. Augment your abilities to destroy your foes and escape before you're out of time!

title: Garden Defence Demo
description: Defend your garden from a bug invasion using everyday objects turned into turrets: magnifying glasses, garden hoses, UV lamps, and more. Upgrade your defenses, adapt to changing weather, and outsmart increasingly cunning enemies in this strategic tower defense with a backyard twist.

title: The Red Weight Demo
description: Mars, Bab al-Hadid habitat. A body in a corridor. A cover-up nobody asked you to crack. Under a sky that will kill you in three minutes, how much weight will you carry for another?

title: KUBB Demo
description: The free demo of Kubb — a roguelike block-stacker where every piece tells a story. Build your deck, survive disasters and step into dimensions with 35 starting blocks. The full game unlocks 30+ more. Easy to learn. Impossible to master. One more run?

title: Toey Weedz Smoke Dead Halloween Demo
description: Oh no! It’s Halloween and Toey Weedz' best friend—the famous rapping cow—has been kidnapped! Save Fatcow in this retro FPS demo. Blast through a spooky meadow, ride a motorcycle, and face a cow-tastic boss! Pure stoner-trash horror built on solid shooter gameplay.

title: Kill The Sea Demo
description: Sail your way to victory on a deadly campaign across the Seven Seas in a seafaring sandbox survivors-like. Hunt menacing beasts of legend, complete deliveries, win races, defend outposts, find treasures or gamble it all in an oceanic world driven by chaos, risk, and opportunity.

title: Sacred Echoes Demo
description: Sacred Echoes is a story-driven souls-like action adventure. Play as The Shattered One and fight alongside your gang of swordsmen and gunslingers across floating islands to confront the man who shattered the Crystal Bound Island. Experience the exclusive prologue section in the demo!

title: 星轨 Star Curve Demo
description: About This GameStar Curve is a single-player logic puzzle game.You awaken in a dilapidated, long-abandoned observatory. Its walls are covered in unfamiliar puzzles, its facilities lie in disrepair, and the story buried within begins to emerge as you explore.

title: 终点站 Demo
description: After a war ended, we were abandoned at the end of the story. Cold winters, intermittently passing typhoons, and occasional seismic waves. The visual novel 『终点站』 will tell a story from the aftermath of war.

title: Negative Edge Demo
description: Annihilate alien hordes and push your combat to the limit in this action-packed Negative Edge DEMO. Experience hybrid combat, grappling hook-based mobility, brutal finishers, and your first encounter with Argus, a biomechanical behemoth.

title: Chinese Pancake Simulator Demo
description: Start with a humble pancake stand, purchase ingredients, cook pancakes, serve customers, and upgrade your equipment as you grow your business day by day.

title: Fabled Kingdoms Demo
description: Play the opening Stormguard campaign and skirmish battles in this demo of a turn-based fantasy strategy game featuring tactical grid-based combat and unique factions.

title: Social Lab Demo
description: Will the Ai fire into the air and cooperate, or shoot you and defect? Social Lab is a simultaneous turn-based strategy game that requires the best choice between cooperation and betrayal. Play a cooperative game with AIs in a social lab that studies human cooperation.

title: Tattered Banners Demo
description: Lead a mercenary company in a turn-based tactics RPG set in a dynamic, simulated world shaped by your actions. Recruit, equip, and evolve your warband to survive a fantasy realm where the land itself changes. This demo showcases core mechanics that will be expanded in the full version of the game.

title: Miaugical Demo
description: Change the world with your magic in Miaugical!, an epic adventure where mysteries abound. Explore the world, uncover secrets, discover your power in an isometric 3D Adventure-RPG style, and face great challenges in a 2D Rogue-Lite, surrounded by cute kittens and not-so-cute enemies.

title: Soul Stone Defense Demo
description: A dark fantasy tower defense and survival game where you build defenses by day and possess your warriors by night to fight off endless waves of monsters.

title: Crystal Wars Demo
description: The Crystal Wars demo is free in your browser: the complete tutorial, Easy & Medium AI, the first campaign chapter (6 levels), and live online multiplayer. The full version adds the Hard AI (real minimax), 4 more campaign chapters, every field setting, and all 26 achievements.

title: Cat Eats Sushi Demo
description: Place sushi to guide a sushi-loving cat in this unique puzzle game.

title: Yunlai Elixir Clinic Demo
description: After Master left, you tend the pill room alone. Visitors bring illnesses, lies, and secrets. As an alchemy apprentice, your only support is the Compendium of Herbal Roots left by Master. With each diagnosis, you discern not just the sickness but the truth drawing closer.

title: GameUP Demo
description: Try GameUP for free: choose an FPS objective, select a running game, capture a real gameplay scene, view results, retest the same scene, and compare runs in a focused workflow. Overlay and advanced advice are locked in this demo.

title: Pickup Point Simulator Demo
description: Run your own parcel pickup point and manage the daily flow of deliveries. Scan incoming packages, organize them by number, verify customer identities, and provide fast, accurate service. Grow your business, improve efficiency, and become the neighborhood's most trusted pickup point.

title: In Tenebris Demo
description: In Tenebris is a dark, first-person sci-fi horror game where echolocation is the only way to find your way out. You see while you make sound, but you can also be heard by those you don't want to be around. Explore the corridors of a research facility, avoid enemies, and try to survive.

title: Duel of Gaia Demo
description: Duel of Gaia is a card-based auto-battle strategy game. Choose a unique elemental deck and dive into battle. Activate powerful skills or summon monsters with your cards, and use the best strategy in auto-combat to defeat your opponents and conquer the continent.

title: 异界少女的轮回血契 Demo
description: Only the winner can leave, and your hands must be stained with blood, using others as a price to fulfill your own desires. Who will be the first to pick up the butcher knife for their desires? Who will be the first to lie through their teeth for their desires?

title: Quest for Choices: Ivan's Tale ｜ Chapter 0+1 Demo
description: ✦Quest for Choices: Ivan's Tale is a choice-driven visual novel. The story mainly follows a Slavic white mouse named "Ivan Viktorovich Belyaev" and its VR memory recordings in the United States.

title: Bullet Rift Demo
description: Bullet Rift is a top-down shooter ARPG packed with loot, builds, dungeons, rifts, crafting, bosses, and deep character progression. Blast through hordes, chase legendary gear, perfect your build, and push deeper into an endgame built for players who love grinding for power.

title: 赤马 Demo
description: 肉鸽地牢玩法的独立游戏，游戏特点是由真人出镜的回合制打斗，多种武学可选，可收集多名美女模特，另外包含丰富的文字剧情。

title: Violet Requiem Demo
description: She never meant to love a monster. She only meant to find her truth. Play the demo for Violet Requiem, an otome visual novel with spicy 18+ illustrated cryptid romance, paranormal investigations, and 5 supernatural love interests to sink your teeth into.

title: Slime Locomotion Demo
description: Inertial sensor-based natural locomotion solution. By capturing human body posture, it enables movement in four directions—forward, backward, left, and right.

title: Pis-to-le-ro Demo
description: Esta demo incluye el modo multijugador local de PIS-TO-LE-RO.Se admite la posibilidad de jugarlo con 1 teclado y 1 mando, o con 2 mandos.

title: Swarmslam Demo
description: Watch a swarm of tiny slammers hurl themselves at a planet and mine it till it breaks, then feed that ore to THE VOID to make your swarm bigger and faster. SLAM, CRACK, REPEAT

title: Darning Demo
description: A cozy game about quietly putting the world back together. Stitch torn, faded cloth and watch hidden color bloom beneath your needle — every piece a small surprise, endlessly new, and yours to keep. No timers. No scores. No failing. Just you, a thread, and the calm of mending.

title: Heroes And Zombies Demo
description: Heroes and Zombies is a high-octane twin-stick shooter where you fight to survive against endless hordes of the undead. Choose your unique hero, collect devastating weapons, and use your reflexes to hold off waves of enemies in this fast-paced action experience.

title: Vampolitics: Vassal of the Void Demo
description: Rule a vampire coven from your throne in deep space. Judge petitioners, manage blood and gold, and face a war you didn't choose. Reign well, or reign briefly.

title: 多眼症 Polyopthalmia Demo
description: A top-down arena shooting game. You need to break every eyeball you see and survive in the arena full of gazes to get a high score

title: Mechanis Obscura Demo
description: MECHANIS OBSCURA is an indie psychological escape-room thriller game, blending FMV cutscenes, 2000s horror vibes, and intricate puzzle mechanisms. After unknowingly enrolling in a deep-web trial, you have been abducted into a nightmarish escape room. No choices, only one reality remains...ESCAPE!

title: PSYCHE Demo
description: A fast paced, difficult, surreal 2nd person arena shooter with secrets, unlockables, backflips and leaderboards.

title: Purification Front (Task Force Purge) DEMO
description: Purification Frontline Demo features a playable slice of the game's core tower-climbing roguelite experience. Fight through battles, events, and upgrade choices, build your squad each run, and experience fast-paced combat with dodging, shooting, and character switching.

title: Anubis: Wrath of the Underworld Demo
ScramBrawl Demo
description: Fight your friends as clumsy, half-boiled eggs in this physics-based party brawler for 1-4 players. Fire your yolk or grab whatever you can to knock out your enemies across hazardous arenas. Scramble your way to victory in hilarious, chaotic brawls!

title: Rever4 Demo
description: A new kind of Reversi for up to 4 players. Rever4 supports single-player, local play, LAN play, and online matches, with multiple rule sets including classic Reversi, 3-Way, 4-Way, Duo, and Quartet.

title: Twilight Tides: Mirage Journey Demo
description: A text-based romance game revolving around the turning Wheel of Fortune tarot card!【Twilight Tides: Mirage Journey】, a narrative romance title built on the creative concept of Tarot Subconscious Choices, is complete!

title: Thugz VS Zombies Demo
description: Build your block defense, recruit wild THUGZ, earn cash, upgrade your crew, and survive the first boss fight in this cartoony tactical zombie defense demo.

title: Throughput Demo
description: Build the city. Watch it breathe. A city sim stripped to its essentials and pushed somewhere new. No popups. No budget spreadsheets. No fires to put out. Just zoning, roads, and a city that responds. Every vehicle, every commuter, every truck calculates its own path.

title: 我主沉浮-Master of Fate's Tides Demo
description: This is an AVG storyline visual game novel, with the addition of ARPG's 2.5D gameplay. You will be the desperate third prince of the Northern Liang Dynasty.You can also control the plot direction through different plot choices, unlock NPC favorability, and unlock new storylines. ﻿

title: Harvest Havoc Demo
description: Harvest Havoc is an auto-fire action roguelike. Move and dodge as swarms sweep across wheat fields, frost, lava, deserts, and the endless void. Choose weapons and passives every level-up, evolve your build, craft companions, and paint your own map to battle on.

title: Meow Paw Cursor : 喵爪光标 Demo
description: A cute cat paw follows your every click, turning your desktop into a living playground. Small, light, and full of warmth.This product is Demo.

title: Observe. Demo
description: Your character is named Mason. After a tragic event, you wake up in the middle of the night unable to leave your room. Your computer screen lights up with 3 levels, only 1 is unlocked currently. Complete the first level to unlock the next.

title: 古都千年 Demo
description: Silk Road town sim. You manage production, survive harsh seasons and diseases. Witness residents' lives from birth to death. Trade via expeditions, meet historical figures. Demo includes core management and trading.

title: Project Refactor Demo
description: 选择注定和失去相伴——那失去之后，还剩下什么？规划每周时间，在事件抉择中经历一段关于选择与和解的人生。

title: Confessional Simulator Demo
description: You're the new priest at St. Augustine's. Sinners kneel on the other side of the screen and tell you everything. Forgive them and your Faith grows. Work the guilt and the donations roll in. Push it too far and the Bishop starts listening. A voiced dark comedy about other people's sins.

title: Borrow or Rob Demo
description: A 1990s-analog sci-fi roguelike deckbuilder built on time inversion. Fight the battle with enemies rewinding the time backward — then you can rewind the time, fight in time inverted environment. Get hints while the first encouter, and revenge them with your own strategy.

title: VORTEX-G: Anti-Gravity Racing & Track Editor Demo
description: Experience the speed of VORTEX-G for free. This demo features Arcade Mode with 3 tracks and 2 fully customizable ships.

title: Miner Survivor Demo
description: Mine. Build. Survive. Defend. A fast-paced survivor defense game where you mine gold, build towers and drones, battle massive enemy hordes, and defeat powerful bosses in an ever-changing underground world.

title: Froggy's Adventures Demo
description: Play the free opening chapter of Froggy's Adventures! Create your own frog and explore cozy Lilypad City — recover the stolen Golden Fly, brave the pitch-dark Mossy Caverns for the sunken crown, and drive back the Oozing to become a hero. About 20 minutes. Wishlist the full 5-chapter adventure!

title: Lost Galaxy: Survivors Demo
description: Defend massive interdimensional portals against relentless alien swarms in this fast-paced sci-fi top-down survival shooter.

title: ChompBurg Demo
description: Control an acolyte of Dracula through the mazeburg, collecting villagers and avoiding the hunters to break the score, customize power ups to trigger your combos and become the hunter, transform Chompburg into a point making machine and discover dopamine blasting synergies!

title: Blek and the Endless Keep Demo
description: Guide Blek through the twisting grey halls of the Endless Keep as they work to get their memories back! Fight back the Keep's monstrous spawn, meet it's unique denizens, and make thorough use of the art of cat necromancy to find your way back home! The Keep can't truly be Endless, can it?

title: 漂流工厂 Demo
description: Gather resources, research technologies, expand platforms, and build conveyor belt networks to survive and thrive in a perilous maritime world. Utilize automated production lines to free up manual labor, keep the factory running continuously, and ultimately build a starship to travel to Mars.

title: Problem Space Demo
description: Venture forth through this puzzle game across space. Use your command terminal to guide the Onlooker interstellar probe through treacherous galaxies to explore the farthest reaches of the universe. Avoid asteroids, perform research tasks, and weave through the stars!

title: Sharp Stock Demo
description: Local game asset manager for developers and artists. Preview 3D models, Spine animations, audio, images, and fonts; pack texture atlases, split sprite sheets, search with tags, and work 100% on your own disk.

title: CRANE GAME QUEST DEMO
description: A simulation game that recreates the Japanese crane game experience. Feel the frustration of the arcade right at home. Use a variety of techniques to win prizes. Unlock prizes and stages as you master the crane game.

title: New Science Demo
description: What if you could rediscover everything humanity has ever invented?New Science is a card combination game that takes you from the Stone Age to the Age of Intelligence, one discovery at a time.Start with the basics. Combine them to make something new. Combine that with something else. Watch history unfold in your hands.

title: 大剑25k：邪恶入侵 Demo
description: This game is an action-adventure game. Your goal is to eliminate all visible alien creatures. You can use shields and sword skills, with two different types of moves. You can parry and killing enemies can restore some stats. Continuous killing is the only way to keep you alive.

title: Kings Call 2 Demo
description: Become the Lord of Silver Heron Ridge in Kings Call 2. Collect cards to summon creatures, cast spells and defeat monsters. Four classes: Mage for area damage, Priest with Holy Light, Ranger for precision, Warrior boosting team power. Cards from White to Gold. Test your strategy and courage!

title: Very Disco, Disco Very! Demo
description: Everyone locks in moves at once, then the simulation takes over. A dense, chaotic programming game for 1 to 8 players where pushes, cards, and chain reactions ensure nothing goes as intended.

title: Golfcremental Demo
description: BUILD! GOLF! EARN! BUY! Turn $50 into your own golfing empire by building custom golf courses and then automating them to get hole in ones. Unlock unique golf course pieces and use them in unique ways to make more money.

title: ZodiacLottery Demo
description: A lottery roguelike. Move animals to create winning tickets, then combine powerful synergies and unique relics to build massive jackpots!

title: BLIGHTEN Demo
description: BLIGHTEN is a survival horror fps set in an abandoned facility overrun by mindless creatures infected by the Blight. Scavenge for resources and do whatever it takes to survive the industrial hellscape you're isolated within.

title: Seagull Lighthouse Demo
description: In a lighthouse, you read letters, write back, and wait. Only a sea, a flock of seagulls that deliver bottles, and bottles that drift in from nowhere, carrying the lives of strangers inside. Your replies may shape their stories. In an age of anxiety and speed, let yourself slow down.

title: Neural Descent Demo
description: A platformer with a twist

title: House Of Trauma Demo
description: Gabriel, a cps worker, has been trapped inside a psychotic mother's house. Will he ESCAPE!?This is a shortened demo meant to be a teaser for the full game, House of Trauma, releasing Halloween of 2026.

title: Super Magic Ball ! Home Run Derby Demo
Sokobomb Demo
description: Sokobomb is a puzzle game about blowing things up to find your way forward.

title: Blob of Ink Demo
description: Blob of Ink is a short incremental game where you grow a tiny living ink blob into something greater.Consume letters, unlock magic powers, gather ink, and evolve into your final form.UNIQUE SKILLSWords are only the beginning - face their living incarnations and consume them.

title: Corefall: Idle Dungeon RPG Demo
description: Assemble a party of heroes, descend into a living 3D dungeon, and watch them fight. A deep idle RPG with TONS of ENDLESS Content!

title: Conquer for Glory Demo
description: A side-on strategy game about raising armies and conquering a dark fantasy world. Lead one of eight races, break the enemy line with troops, monsters and unique abilities, and take the map kingdom by kingdom.

title: Thrice-a-dice Demo
description: Trice-a-Dice is a roguelike Dice-Builder. Roll dice to earn money. Raplace dice faces for better ones and combine into the best. Buy Cats to create synergies with faces and upgrades. Deal with the Devil, gamble in slot machine and buy Angel's help. All of this just to pay to play further.

title: Nicu Ștefan Cristian's Mongol 2 Demo
description: Story:You are food. You've always been food. You came onto this world to be consumed, to be devoured by your primordial creators. How unfortunate that you learnt about it at the end of the times, the Ante-Diotoromus. But not all is lost.

title: Aevalore Demo
description: No dialogue. No filler. Just chaos. Choose a hero, master their 81 skill combinations, survive the 10-minute horde across deadly maps. With 300,000+ build combinations, how will you survive? Level up, play your cards right, and conquer the bosses. AEVALORE: Your hero, your build, YOUR CHOICE.

title: The Dark Forest Calls Demo
description: Explore an isolated village swallowed by darkness and fog. Search for supplies, manage limited resources, use light carefully, and survive a slow-burn first-person horror experience where every sound can matter.

title: Stellar Harvest Demo
description: Play the opening of Stellar Harvest for free. Build your planetary energy empire, experience your first prestige, and begin the journey toward constructing a Dyson Sphere.

title: Silly Typing Game Demo
description: A lightning-fast typing roguelike where vocabulary meets high-octane arcade survival. Adapt to shifting HUDs, chaotic bosses, and brutal viruses across procedural runs. But beware: the more efficiently you type, the closer the interface looks back at you.

title: Uptime: A Cloud Provider Sim Demo
description: Build a cloud provider from a garage to a hyperscaler - rack the hardware, run every cable, route the traffic, keep customers online. A first-person infrastructure sim where ports, power, fault domains, RSTP and BGP do real work, not flavour text. Readable for newcomers, honest for engineers.

title: SLANT Demo
description: A 2D puzzle platformer game where you reach the goal point by overcoming various traps and puzzles.

title: Tiny Towers Demo
description: A short incremental game about defending your tiny fortress from hordes of tiny mobs. Place towers, gain resources by defeating enemies, and unlock new upgrades in the skill tree to strengthen your goblin stronghold.

title: System Cleaner Demo
description: Bullet heaven meets base building. System Cleaner is a survivorslike set inside a broken computer, where you fight corrupted files and place helpful buildings as you go. Clean up waves of glitches your way: dodge and shoot through the chaos, or build a growing setup that does the work for you.

title: Snake: Gridbreaker Demo
description: Play the first loop of Snake: Gridbreaker. Defeat the Gatekeeper, unlock Ghost Snake, progress Anomaly Signal, and carry your save into the full game.

title: DUSK OF WAR Demo
description: DUSK OF WAR is an idle clicker incremental war management game. As the WAR MINISTER, you are in charge of the army, the industry, the finances and the logistics. PROTECT YOUR COUNTRY TODAY!

title: Flat Mars Demo
description: Flat Mars is an action roguelike FPS. Shoot your way through millions of demons and tear through the terrain with an arsenal of futuristic weapons to claim powerful relics.

title: Ultimate Wizard Demo
description: Destroy thousands of enemies and grow in power in this fantasy roguelite survivor. Find spells and augment them, equip build defining items, discover secrets, level up and set out to become the ultimate wizard!

title: At Face Value Demo
description: Every card is worth exactly what it says, so draw a few thousand of them. At Face Value is a witty, deceptively deep incremental about turning one humble deck of cards into a runaway point-printing machine. Draw, upgrade, shuffle, repeat… just one more time.

title: UnderWorldMonstersPinball Demo
description: Introducing *Underworld Monsters Pinball*, a fresh take on pinball where you aim for high scores with a cast of quirky monster characters riding the ball! Hone your skills and aim for your personal best score!

title: Edicts of the Truthsinger: The Orb of Artemagus Demo
description: Six witnesses, six suspects, and thousands of discoverable lines of dialog. You're the fantasy detective on the case of a stolen magical artifact, and in order to determine the truth you'll have to cross examine, interrogate, and reference all your resources to catch the thief before time runs out.

title: Re:collect Demo
description: In a postwar world where even memories can be used as collateral, you become the owner of a small pawnshop. Speak with customers, judge the value of their memories and belongings, and over 30 days of running the shop, uncover forgotten truths and the story of the protagonist.

title: Escape From Ashville Demo
description: Loot, fight and extract — or lose everything. A high-risk extraction shooter focused on survival, tactical combat, and meaningful decisions.

title: Son of Beach Demo
description: Start as a Beach Caretaker Intern. Clean up trash left behind by tourists and recycle it to unlock powerful new tools. Follow the changing tides to dig up hidden treasures beneath the sand. Catch seafood, run your own seafood stand, and sell rare coastal collectibles in your treasure shop.

title: UpDown&Shot Demo
description: Load the revolver and guess the dealer's number. Wrong? Then put the barrel to your head and pull the trigger.

title: Paironix Demo
description: A fast-paced, rogue-like tile-matching adventure! Connect identical pairs to unleash powerful magic spells, adapt to shifting grids, and draft game-changing upgrades. Can you survive the ever-evolving trials in this striking minimalist vector world?

title: Mercenary Brotherhood Demo
description: A deep turn‑based tactics RPG featuring emergent stories, procedural world events, enemy factions, magical loot with drawbacks, and a fully simulated fantasy sandbox. Build your mercenary company, survive brutal battles, and uncover new content. Solo‑dev indie project with active development.

title: Huiyu AI Trip Demo
description: Huiyu AI Trip is an interactive travel experience — a visual journey you can control. Hold W/D to move forward through the scene, hold S/A to rewind time backwards, release to pause. flicker-free forward and reverse playback.

title: Escape Them Demo
description: A silent stealth horror game. No weapons, no power just hiding spots, tricks, and nerve. Find the key, escape the house, and don't let them hear you

title: Teen Hustler Demo
description: Build your digital empire from a cramped room to a high-tech penthouse. Code, hack, mine crypto, and manipulate the dark web in this deep 3D economic sandbox simulator. Stay in the shadows, manage your hardware, and don't get caught by the police!

title: A Vessel of Frustration Demo
description: You return to your hometown but no one recognizes you. But that doesn’t matter, because you are not here for them. You are here for her. Midgårdsormen, singer and artist, pervert and goddess, a being truly out of this world.

title: Leukocyte Demo
description: Action-adventure game for solo play or with friends. Fight viruses and bacteria, gain DNA mutations, and develop new abilities as you explore the human body and face challenging bosses.

title: Capy Farm Demo
description: A short incremental game where you build a farm run entirely by capybaras. Expand your fields, automate production, earn massive profits, and outperform rival farms to win the Grand Harvest Competition.

title: Voxel Breakers Demo
description: Voxel Breakers - a relaxing incremental game where you break voxels, buy and upgrade breaker robots, then watch them break voxels for you faster and faster.

title: Cleanup Crew Demo
description: A space station has gone dark and its captive alien specimens are loose. Fight through procedurally generated rooms, solve each planet's terminal puzzle, and unlock new weapons as you clear three hostile worlds in this 2D roguelite.

title: Crop and Claw 2 Demo
description: Crop and Claw 2 is an Adventure-RPG about dragons, plants, memories, and more. Delve into a whole new continent of secrets and unearth the roots of the strange events going on.

title: SwipSwap Demo
description: You are about to enter Dracoulous' Castle. And for what? A hefty price on his head! Countless minions, bosses and traps stand between you and him.. As a Shadow Dancer, you will have to coordinate with your duo, the shade. Use it to your advantage:### Combine your Dash and your Swip/Swap to overcome Bosses!

title: Climbing Simplified Demo
description: A minimalist physics-based climbing puzzle game where every move matters. Plan your moves, manage stamina, and master different climbing disciplines. The demo will include 20 routes within the first two environments: Gym and Granite.

title: Inimigo - The Warrior Saint Versus the God of Discord- Demo
description: Is one the villain and the other the hero? The truth is more complicated than that. Discover the story between two enemies in this dark fantasy BL visual novel!

title: Derples Vs Xenos Demo
description: DEMO . Lead a squad of Derples in a desperate fight for survival amid abandoned colonial outposts. Build defences, explore dark un-powered rooms, scavenge for resources, fight turn based battles in an alien-infested hellscape. Solo only for Demo (4-player co-op for the full game). Coming soon!

title: Ultimate Guess Game Demo
description: Ultimate Guess Game is a thrilling digital social game. Challenge a friend and race to identify the mystery image you are holding using strategic "Yes/No" questions. With diverse categories to choose from, use your deduction skills to win! Can you solve the puzzle before your opponent does?

title: Little Battle Simulator
description: Create the battlefield of your dreams and fight! Monsters, vast armies, rivers and forests, multiple teams… Anything goes! Create your own battle in "Sandbox". Witness the chaos in "Random Battle", Achieve the highest possible score in "Challenge"

title: Droning On Demo
description: Write code that looks and feels just like Python to guide Gizmo through the first 10 Bootcamp levels. A free taste of the full game, where puzzles and procedural runs push you, and your code, to the limit.

title: Dont Bust Demo
description: The BlackJack rogelike, Don't Bust is a fast paced take at blackjack, collect your augments, drink your Neon Shots and try not to bust.

title: SPER Apocalypse Demo
description: A dark survival RPG set in a post-apocalyptic world where a mysterious virus has changed humanity forever. Fight to survive, uncover the truth, and face the consequences of infection.

title: Escape from Umbra Demo
description: Immerse yourself in a survival horror escape room experience. Trapped in a mysterious world of darkness where shadows lurk, your only help is a secret book and a flashlight. Solve the enigmas and move unseen to escape Umbra’s domain.

title: Wizard Magic DEMO
description: An autistic wizard and their ADHD familiar go on the adventure of a lifetime. Make strange friends, battle wizards and monsters, and explore the magical city of Bizzaire in this bite-sized pixel-art RPG!

title: Seek Shellter Demo
description: Seek Shellter is an arcade-style pathfinder full of cute snails who must collect batteries and seek shelter before the timer runs out. Team up with a friend or go solo to clear levels, win minigames and unlock worlds steeped in retro-60s atomic charm. Do you have what it takes to beat the bomb?

title: Mr. Grin's Final Act Demo
description: Thirty years ago, a tragedy silenced the studio. You are back... So is Mr. Grin. In this first-person survival horror, scavenge old badges, rewire circuits, crack safes. Stay out of sight. One sound and you die. He's not only hunting you. His script. Your survival.

title: Aster League: 2179 Demo
description: Aster League: 2179 is a kart racing spinoff to the small vehicles content of BallisticNG. Boost is king, and piloting in a straight line is a sure-fire way to lose the race.
